meta.name: board-meeting
meta.description: Multi-agent board meeting protocol for strategic decisions. Runs a structured 6-phase deliberation: context loading, independent C-suite contributions (isolated, no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction. Use when the user invokes /cs:boardroom, calls a board meeting, or wants structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.

copy.tagline: 用多角色模拟会议来推演战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队讨论前先系统性地评估多个视角
copy.tagline_en: Simulate a multi-agent board meeting to deliberate strategic decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured multi-perspective deliberation before making a strategic call

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会模拟一场由多个高管角色（如CEO、CFO等）参与的董事会会议。它会依次执行6个阶段：加载背景信息、让每位高管独立发表意见（互不干扰）、由批评者分析、综合各方观点、等待你（创始人）审批，最后记录决策。
howto.when: 当你输入“/cs:boardroom”加上议题，或直接说“召开董事会会议”，或要求对战略问题进行多角度讨论时触发。

say.text: 召开董事会会议，讨论是否在Q3进军西班牙市场。
say.note: Claude会启动6阶段流程，模拟高管讨论并给出决策建议。

say.text: 用/cs:boardroom分析我们产品方向是否该转向AI。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude simulates a board meeting with multiple executive roles (e.g., CEO, CFO). It runs a 6-phase process: load context, independent contributions (no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type "/cs:boardroom" with a topic, say "call a board meeting", or ask for structured multi-perspective deliberation on a strategic question.

say_en.text: Call a board meeting to discuss whether to expand to Spain in Q3.
Use /cs:boardroom to analyze if our product direction should pivot to AI.
say_en.note: Claude activates relevant roles (e.g., CEO, CPO, CTO) for independent analysis.
